the treatment of a common complication of childhood nephrotis syndrome (NS), namely, the frequent relapses which occur after upper respiratory tract infections.
the use of low-dose daily corticosteriods during URTIs to reduce relapses in children with steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome.
the treatment of childhood nephrotics with corticosteroids.
